_why: Machine-readable requirements + mass baseline for the vnext MINIMAL flight variant (ADR-089, accepted 2026-11-25). Follows the repo's single-source-of-truth pattern (docs/ssot/parameters.json): one parameter, one owner, one canonical value. Provenance is mandatory per docs/analysis/ conventions: MEASURED (who/what/when), REPO (in-repo file), OPERATOR (operator-stated, this task brief), TODO(unverified) (no source carries it yet).
_rule: Do not fill a TODO(unverified) slot without its measurement. Update this file as ADR-089's gates (G1-G6, docs/fab/VNEXT-MINIMAL-PLAN.md) land. A gate output that contradicts a value here supersedes the value HERE, not in the ADR prose.
